newsitem.title: CHINA: China power sector seeking 20 pct foreign funds.
newsitem.headline: China power sector seeking 20 pct foreign funds.

text.p: China's power sector is seeking to boost the proportion of foreign funds in its total investment to around 20 percent by the year 2000, the International Business Daily said on Monday.

The sector should explore more overseas bond and stocks issues and seek foreign partners for nuclear, hydrological and alternative power projects, the newspaper said, quoting Minister of Power Industry Shi Dazhen.
The bulk of foreign funds used in the power industry would continue to be soft loans, it quoted Shi as saying.
"At the same time (the sector) will work to widen channels of direct foreign investment, including promoting the BOT (build, operate, transfer) method," Shi said.
Use of foreign funds should give priority to domestically made equipment and exploiting resources in the underdeveloped central and western regions, he said but gave no further details.
